        13                  REVEREND YOUNG:    Thank you,

        14       Senator.

        15                  As we stand underneath the State

        16       Seal, the seal is the motto "Excelsior," "ever

        17       upward," and it replaced the place of the

        18       crown in 1777.  Lady Liberty, with a peasant

        19       cap, represents democratic rule that has left

        20       her left foot stepping on the crown,

        21       representing the rejection of royalty.

        22                  As citizens of the Empire State, we

        23       have been the leader with our Constitution,

        24       twelve years before the federal Constitution.

        25       And as a national leader You have given these
